info.cls_ename: Honor Program of Information and Electrical Engineering

description.describe_ch: 此課程是一門基礎數學課程，旨在介紹矩陣理論與線性代數的基本原理。課程內容以對其它學科有用的主題為主，包括線性方程式系統、行列式、向量空間、內積空間、線性轉換、特徵值與特徵向量。
description.describe_eh: This is a basic subject of mathematics. The aim is to present the fundamentals of matrix theory and linear algebra. Emphasis is given to topics, that will be useful in other disciplines, including systems of linear equations, determinants, vector spaces, inner product spaces, linear transformations, eigenvalues, and eigenvectors.

targets.describe_ch: 1. 知道線性方程式系統與矩陣之間的關係。
targets.describe_en: 1. Clearly understand the relationship between the system of linear equations and matrices.

targets.describe_ch: 2. 理解矩陣的性質及運算。
targets.describe_en: 2. Clear understand the properties of matrices and be familiar with their associated operations and applications.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new: 1. 學期成績計算項目及權重標準如下： (a) Final exam: 30% (b) Midterm exam: 30% (c) Quiz average: 40% 2. 考試（Final exam、Midterm exam、Quiz）： 考試採用筆試，內容包含所有講授內容與參考書中部分教材。期中考、期末考均配合學校考試時程。小考共4次，目的在培養學生平時複習的學習習慣。小考時間均已排定在課程進度表中。 3. 習題（Exercise）： 勤於演練是工程科系學生的必要歷程，學生除上課需特別注意講解之外，課餘應多花時間閱讀與反覆練習。每一章節講授結束均指定習題演練，督促學生能真正瞭解授課內容與熟練解題方法。習題不收回批改評分，以訓練學生具有主動學習精神。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
線性代數課程須知

1.考試四次，兩次小考(各10%)，兩次大考(各30%)

2.平常分數20%，包含作業14次一次總分一分，出席(3%)，印象分數(3%)

3.作業幾乎每周都有，事先勾選好，請在截止日完成，逾時不候，沒有補繳

4.繳作業請把所有內容拍在一張照片中或者是一頁PDF中

5.作業的答案都在課本後面，所以沒甚麼好抄別人的

6.課程中會有遊戲，可以幫考試加分

7.翻轉教室會有勳章，勳章的作用等到翻轉開始之後再說明

8.勳章只是一種榮耀，不拿不會死，但拿了包柏會幫你廣播，並且疼愛你，還可以幫考試加保險分

9.線性代數第四章是flatline的開始，很容易gg，所以不要以為前三章都學過就輕忽

10.上課用講義全英文，考試也是全英文。

11.上課時需要帶紙張作答

12.以上叮嚀請學徒們銘記在心



What You Need to Know About Linear Algebra Courses



1. Exam four times, two quiz (10% each), two major exams (30% each).

2. The usual score is 20%, including 14 assignments (a total score of one point for each), attendance (3%), impression score (3%).

3. There are homeworks almost every week, please check it in advance, please complete it on the deadline, no overtime, no make-up payment.

4. Please take all the content in a photo or a PDF page when submitting homework.

5. The homework answers are all at the back of the textbook, so there is nothing to copy from others (I have also provide you with a pdf file).

6. There will be games in the course, which can help the exam score.

7. There will be medals in the flipped classroom, and the function of the medals will be explained.

8. The medal is just a kind of honor, if you don’t get it, you won’t die, but if you earn it, Bob will broadcast for you and love you, and it can also help the exam to increase insurance points.

9. The fourth chapter of linear algebra is the beginning of flatline, it is easy to gg, so don’t ignore it just because you have learned the first three chapters.

10. Lectures are all in English, and exams are also in English.

11. Need to bring blank paper sheets to answer questions in class.

12. Apprentices please keep in mind the above exhortations.
